implemented: Machine-readable exact pair handshake contracts in scripts/release-identity.mjs, scripts/release-evidence.mjs, and scripts/release-candidate.mjs: distinct BFF image digest types (oci_manifest_digest, image_config_digest, archive_checksum - never conflated), lease ({ owner, epoch, runId, delegated }), preparedArtifact ({ locator, checksum }), expectedPredecessor ({ pairId, commit, artifactDigest, target }), compatibilityDigest, releaseId, and mandatory gate evidence.

Positive prepare protocol in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh: stages exact dev-public-origin FE assets, qualifies candidate against staged non-public BFF via PANTHEON_BFF_CANDIDATE_TRANSPORT, leaves incumbent live symlink untouched, emits durable prepared_success in release-evidence hash chain and writes .prepared-receipt.json, exiting 0.

Positive activate protocol in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh: executes in a new process without rebuilding, verifies prepared receipt and fresh same-epoch environment lease, enforces expected predecessor CAS and mandatory gate evidence, atomically exchanges DEPLOY_ROOT symlink, and verifies independent served readback. Idempotent replay succeeds without rebuilding or re-staging.
Retired one-shot public-switch bypass in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh without compatibility alias; unauthenticated or unphased execution fails closed with exit code 2.
Aligned proof watchdog caller in .github/workflows/pantheon-proof-watchdog.yml to explicit restore action (PANTHEON_DEPLOY_ACTION: restore) and authenticated safe sibling CAS.
Updated .github/workflows/pantheon-dev-fe-deploy.yml to expose separate prepare and activate dispatches, lease inputs, candidate transport, and prepared step/job outputs.
Updated .github/workflows/pantheon-integration-gate.yml to support lease parameters and BFF image digest forwarding while respecting GitHub Actions 25-input dispatch limit.

p1_corrections_addressed.1_workflow_prepare_profiles: In .github/workflows/pantheon-dev-fe-deploy.yml, prepare sets PANTHEON_DEPLOY_REAL_WRITES=false and PANTHEON_DEPLOY_ALLOW_DEV_STUB_WRITES=false, and deploy-dev-vm.sh accepts read-only flags during prepare. In test-deploy-dev-vm.sh, run_write_deploy and run_operator_live_deploy pass false write flags in prepare and true write flags in activate. All 42 contract cases pass.
p1_corrections_addressed.2_candidate_transport_routing: probe-hosted-browser-bff.mjs reads PANTHEON_BFF_CANDIDATE_TRANSPORT and intercepts browser requests via Playwright route fulfillment, routing traffic to the bound non-public candidate transport while keeping the public origin unchanged and incumbent untouched.
p1_corrections_addressed.3_bff_image_identity_enforcement: In release-identity.mjs and release-candidate.mjs, contradictory typed and primary digests are rejected. createReleaseIdentity enforces caller image metadata against observed live image metadata. verifyVersionAgainstIdentity requires full image identity match (repo, tag, digest, digestType).
p1_corrections_addressed.4_candidate_transport_cors_and_url_guard: probe-hosted-browser-bff.mjs strictly guards candidate transport URLs against non-mvl-cap/internal domains, credentials, and cloud metadata (IPv4 and IPv6-mapped IPv4). Browser CORS is strictly enforced in route interception: missing or non-matching access-control-allow-origin triggers route.abort('failed').
p1_corrections_addressed.5_receipt_authority_and_integrity: .prepared-receipt.json includes sha256 HMAC/integrity covering all payload fields, TTL (3600s), lease ({ owner, epoch, runId, delegated }), BFF image ({ repository, tag, digest, digestType }), preparedArtifact ({ locator, checksum }), expectedPredecessor ({ target, commit, pairId, artifactDigest }), and mandatory gates (candidateVerification, preSwitchProbe, agoraCompatibility, managementFleet, openclawContract). All validated in verify_prepared_receipt.
p1_corrections_addressed.6_replay_and_recovery_receipt_validation: activate calls verify_prepared_receipt and verify_dist_digest before any replay or state transition. Predecessor CAS enforces all 4 fields (target, commit, pairId, artifactDigest) against both live state and expected receipt predecessor when switching.
p1_corrections_addressed.7_parent_composition_and_downstream_cont: pantheon-dev-fe-deploy.yml exposes separate workflow dispatch inputs for deploy_action, lease parameters, and candidate transport, with step/job outputs for prepared_release_dir and prepared_receipt. Pruning preserves unexpired prepared receipts. Restore validates lease parameters if provided, emitting restore.fe_half_complete for parent pair composition handover to DEV-DELIVERY-001 and STRUCT-RETIRE-001.

downstream_handover_contract.DEV-DELIVERY-001: FE deployment interface exposes separated PANTHEON_DEPLOY_ACTION=prepare (outputs prepared-release-dir, .prepared-receipt.json with TTL 3600s) and PANTHEON_DEPLOY_ACTION=activate (requires lease_owner, lease_epoch, lease_run_id, lease_delegated, predecessor CAS). Pruning retains unexpired prepared receipts. Failure during activate retains safe sibling for parent rollback.
downstream_handover_contract.STRUCT-RETIRE-001: One-shot switch bypass is permanently retired with exit code 2. No compatibility aliases exist. All deployments must execute through governed prepare -> activate or explicit restore.
